scope: GNU aligned typedef metadata, target layout/query rules, and fail-closed Rust alias projection.
GCC/Clang arithmetic typedef identity is explicitly unsupported when alignment could be changed; profile probes are included for the next layer.
Real translation units advance beyond their aligned typedef failures but still reject unrelated unsupported attributes or intrinsics.

validation.native_ffi: GCC and Clang x86_64 Linux, including C and Win64 calling conventions; redundant aligned(16) aliases exercise the existing int128 calls/callbacks/records oracle.

commands.affinity: Build/tests CPU2,3; baseline build CPU4,5; measurement harnesses CPU2.
commands.measurement_script:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib
cache=Path('/home/dev-user/.cache/toucan')
def matching_target(root):
    probe=Path('/tmp/toucan-alignment-crate-probe.rs')
    probe.write_text('fn main(){toucan_semantic::analyze("",toucan_target::Target::X86_64UnknownLinuxGnu).unwrap();}')
    for target in (root/'deps').glob('libtoucan_target-*.rlib'):
        command=['rustc','--edition=2024','--emit=metadata',str(probe),'--extern',f'toucan_semantic={root}/libtoucan_semantic.rlib','--extern',f'toucan_target={target}','-L',f'dependency={root}/deps','-o','/tmp/toucan-alignment-crate-probe.rmeta']
        if subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True).returncode == 0:return target
    raise RuntimeError(f'no matching target artifact in {root}')
for label,folder in [('baseline','aligned-typedef-baseline-target'),('changed','aligned-typedefs-target')]:
 root=cache/folder/'release';deps=root/'deps';target=matching_target(root)
 for name,source in [('alloc','/tmp/toucan-checked-allocations.rs'),('size','/tmp/toucan-type-size.rs')]:
  output=f'/tmp/toucan-aligned-typedef-{name}-{label}'
  command=['rustc','--edition=2024','-O',source,'--extern',f'toucan_semantic={root}/libtoucan_semantic.rlib','--extern',f'toucan_target={target}','-L',f'dependency={deps}','-o',output]
  subprocess.run(command,check=True)
  result=subprocess.check_output(['taskset','-c','2',output],text=True)
  Path(output+'.txt').write_text(result);print(label,name,result.strip(),flush=True)
root=cache/'aligned-typedefs-target/release';deps=root/'deps';target=matching_target(root)
for name,source in [('corpus','/tmp/toucan-type-ownership-corpus.rs'),('semantic','/home/dev-user/.cache/toucan/translation-unit-audit/semantic_probe.rs')]:
 output=f'/tmp/toucan-aligned-typedef-{name}'
 command=['rustc','--edition=2024','-O',source,'--extern',f'toucan_semantic={root}/libtoucan_semantic.rlib','--extern',f'toucan_target={target}','-L',f'dependency={deps}','-o',output]
 subprocess.run(command,check=True)
 if name=='corpus':
  result=subprocess.check_output(['taskset','-c','2',output],text=True);Path(output+'.log').write_text(result);print(result,flush=True)
original=json.loads((cache/'translation-unit-audit/evidence.json').read_text());rows=[]
for case in original['cases']:
 if case['id'] not in ['libgit2-alloc','libgit2-repository','zstd-zstd_common']:continue
 for retain in [False,True]:
  command=['/tmp/toucan-aligned-typedef-semantic',case['preprocessed']]+(['--retain'] if retain else [])
  result=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','2',*command],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=30)
  row={'case':case['id'],'mode':'direct_semantic','retention':retain,'command':command,'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(case['preprocessed']).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'exit_code':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr};rows.append(row);print(case['id'],retain,result.returncode,(result.stderr+result.stdout).strip(),flush=True)
(cache/'aligned-typedef-tu-audit/direct-semantic.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
